basic_info.description: Welcome to life at The Sutterfield, one of San Francisco's premier living experiences. Home No. 1001 is a highly desirable, grand 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom northeast corner unit boasting breathtaking city views from every room and incredible natural light throughout. Crafted with entertaining in mind, the living and dining areas flow seamlessly together creating a dramatic open floor plan with floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing a stunning city backdrop. The renovated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, updated cabinets/hardware, and an eat-in breakfast bar. Enjoy a king-sized bedroom with multiple nooks for a home office, and Salesforce Tower outlooks. The bedroom suite is complete with a spacious walk-in closet, second closet, full-size washer/dryer, and beautiful en-suite bathroom. This gorgeous home boasts new white oak flooring, custom Hunter Douglas blinds, and one independent parking space. The Sutterfield amenities include: 24/7 front desk concierge/security, fitness center, outdoor hot tub and lounging deck, sauna, terrace, and stately lobby entrance with library. With a 99 Walk Score, you are steps to Whole Foods, Lafayette Park, Polk Street & the new Van Ness corridor for shopping & dining. Walk to work, the Symphony, Opera, SF Jazz, and Ballet. Welcome home!
